visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing an oversized blue-and-white striped button-down shirt and blue jeans, enters the scene through a pink-framed archway in a brightly lit studio. He gestures towards a shelf filled with high-heeled shoes and smiles broadly. (2) He stands next to a large presentation board titled '多功能網美風小宅,' which features several photos of home interiors. He speaks enthusiastically to a group off-camera, his hands moving to emphasize his points. (3) The man holds a pink frame containing a photo of a modern living room, while text overlays detail the size and cost of his renovation. (4) In a humorous moment, he pretends to walk away through the archway, then quickly turns back, laughing with the other people in the studio. (5) He sits on a tall white stool and points to specific details on the presentation board, explaining the versatile functions of his home office. Three women and another man sit nearby, reacting with laughter and surprised facial expressions. (6) The camera zooms in on the board as he highlights a specific photo of a television cabinet with black glass doors. (7) Finally, he stands behind a large 3D logo for '女人我最大 Queen,' holding a small white card and smiling at the camera, concluding his presentation.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 女人我最大 Queen. [Subtitle]: 今天我們來到. (2) [Subtitle]: 要來分享關於家裡裝潢的細節. (3) [Subtitle]: 不過我發現我好像不應該待在這裡呢. (4) [Slogan]: 多功能網美風小宅 26坪 裝潢330萬. [Subtitle]: 本來是要分享我們的家裝潢. (5) [Subtitle]: 可是我看到腳本 他們每個人都是上千萬的裝潢. (6) [Subtitle]: 不是房子 是裝潢. [Variety]: 我先下班! (7) [Variety]: 大家掰掰. (8) [Subtitle]: 開玩笑的啦 話說我的裝潢可是為了我的工作室量身訂做的. (9) [Subtitle]: 例如說我可能在這邊背景拍影片. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後另外一個門拉起來 可以變成是我可以錄Podcast的地方. [Variety]: 哦~!. (11) [Subtitle]: 每一個小地方都有它的功能. (12) [Subtitle]: 拉開就變居家攝影棚. [Variety]: 對對對!. (13) [Subtitle]: 裡面還有一個是化妝台. [Variety]: 哇噻! (大家超羨募). (14) [Variety]: 怎麼可能 真的假 為什麼26坪還可以塞一個化妝台. (15) [Variety]: 我們130坪 我老公都沒有給我一個化妝台. (16) [Subtitle]: 而且我還有一個貼心的小設計哦 黑色玻璃(客廳電視櫃下方收網處). (17) [Subtitle]: 是所有的感應器可以藏在裡面. (18) [Subtitle]: 可是它又是黑色的 所以呢女生如果坐在這邊都不會反光. (19) [Subtitle]: 也不會看到他的那個安全褲什麼的 算是個小貼心啦. (20) [Subtitle]: 你家也有什麼特別的裝潢嗎 留言跟我分享吧. [Logo]: 女人我最大 Queen.
